headline: Spain to extend banking tax through 2027 to fund housing policies
summary: The Spanish government announced it will extend its windfall tax on banks through 2027. The measure is expected to generate €1.4 billion to support national housing policies.
why: Windfall taxes on financial institutions are a recurring political tool in Europe to redistribute profits from high interest rates toward social spending, impacting bank profitability and investor sentiment in the sector.

impacts.name: Spanish Banking Sector
impacts.why: The extension of the tax reduces net income for banks operating in Spain.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
